title: The volcano
description: The player leaves Olmec's Lair by its door and walks right through a cave above a lake of lava to a big chest. The chest opens and a giant golden head pops out beside him; lava wells up under the stone platform they stand on and lifts it, and outside the volcano erupts, throwing the player and the treasure into the sky.
